source.rights: Third-party seller artwork selected by the Owner as calibration evidence. Never reproduce, never pass to a generator as image input, never publish. Only the transferable principles leave this record.
source.campaign_title_visible: August Estate Auction — Over 725+ Lots & Growing

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Left ~35%: seller name (green serif, gold ampersand) → AUGUST ESTATE AUCTION (gold spaced caps) → OVER 725+ LOTS & GROWING (725+ as a huge gold numeral) → category line → Auction begins / date / time. Right ~65%: seven objects on a white stage with white plinths. Green footer band with gold URL.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Pair of bronze urns on marble pedestals, black-and-gold chinoiserie breakfront (tall structure at the back), amethyst geode on stand (right), framed drawing leaning at mid-right, green-leather writing table (left-mid), carved wood lion group on a white plinth (centre), pair of red chrome cantilever chairs (right foreground). Soft shadows.
visual_read.composition_style: Editorial set: literal white plinths and a white floor, objects arranged by height (tall back, low front), red chairs as the colour anchor.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Forest-green serif seller name; gold spaced caps; the numeral 725+ as the hero type; small caps for categories; gold flourish dividers.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller name leads top-left; URL in the footer band only.
visual_read.footer_treatment: Full-width green band with a thin gold rule and gold 'LMAuctionCo.com' with flourishes.
visual_read.photographic_style: Extracted catalogue photography staged on a white set; consistent soft top light.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: A staged showroom floor with plinths — an explicit 'set', not a room.

strongest_attributes: A verifiable fact (725+ lots) made into the hero typographic element
Full-width footer band carrying the URL — closes the ad cleanly
Tall cabinet gives vertical structure; low furniture and red chairs ground the front (matches the supplemental 3M calibration language almost word for word)
One short category line, not a pile of labels
transferable_lessons: Footer band + wordmark validated as a brand-frame device (3M.2 navy band)
A factual catalogue claim (lot count) may be the primary message when it is true at generation time and re-verified before publishing
The 'one short supporting line' slot may be a category line (≤ 6 words)
Tall structure at the back + heavy anchors in front is the Owner's preferred vertical logic
do_not_generalize: Green/gold palette and the green band — the Advantage.Bid band is navy and does not change per event
White plinths as literal props (Advantage.Bid uses contact shadows and an implied floor, not furniture-store plinths, unless the Owner asks)
Seller serif faces and flourish glyphs

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Five blocks, but one is a single huge numeral and one is a category line; the panel reads top-to-bottom in a glance.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: Exactly at budget; demonstrates that big typography for one fact is preferable to more lines.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Showroom set: back row tall, front row low; objects on plinths and floor.
composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: Everything grounded on the white floor or a plinth; the framed drawing leans against the cabinet.
composition_assessment.depth: Two to three planes; overlap is light — objects mostly sit beside rather than in front of each other.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Cabinet and urns as tall anchors; table and lion mid; chairs as the colour accent at full scale.

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
